faq.question: Q1. What is the THSTI Front desk Executive cum Receptionist recruitment?
faq.answer: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) has invited candidates for a walk-in interview to fill 1 contract vacancy for the Front desk Executive cum Receptionist post through an outsourced agency.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Front desk Executive cum Receptionist post.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 23rd October 2026 (Friday) at 09:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), NCR Biotech Science Cluster, 3rd Milestone, Faridabad - Gurugram Expressway, Faridabad - 121001.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university with one year of relevant experience.
